name: Halo
description: A soft radial glow sits centred on the pointer. It brightens as the pointer speeds up and breathes gently once the pointer comes to rest, dimming to its idle level before it fades away.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Radius
parameters.description: Radius of the glow around the pointer (px)

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Brightness of the glow at the pointer

parameters.name: Speed gain
parameters.description: How much brighter the glow gets when the pointer moves fast

parameters.name: Idle dim
parameters.description: Brightness the glow settles to while the pointer rests, as a share of full
